title: 50% off Cozze Pizza Ovens: Standard 13" Electric $195.60, 17" Gas $239.60 + $15 Delivery @ Cozze
body:
Deal: 50% off Cozze Pizza Ovens: Standard 13" Electric $195.60, 17" Gas $239.60 + $15 Delivery @ Cozze

[Packab] Subscription/membership code is the same as the OP has mentioned. I tried, same code. So, 10% off according to my buttons.
Still, seems pretty good but I do not see any SPECS….what's included??? gas reg plus line?? hard to tell.
More info please
[ESEMCE] I just checked out the 13".
Seems like the "sliceof10" code is applying 20%.
Subtotal: $244.50
Discount: -$48.90
Shipping: Flat rate $15.00
Total: $210.60
[Packab] ok. Will look again.
I like the oven…looks good. Anyone have first hand experience with the LPG version???
[furBug] Yeah I had the 13” classic for a couple of years, and upgraded to the gozney arc when bbqs galore were going out of business.
It’s a good oven. Heats up in 30 mins, takes a bit longer between pizzas to rebound, the stone could have been a bit thicker. But you can make a good pizza with it. Need a decent peel and good dough recipe for best results.
FWIW I paid 299 at Bunnings in 2024
[BlitzR] Of course it comes with the reg & line, every LPG device that I've purchased in Australia has come with one. I'm sure it will also come with the pizza stone inside the oven, plus user manual.
What more info do you actually want?
[m13] Saw this a couple of days ago but after reading about the quality of them, decided to go with the Ooni Koda 12 from Amazon for 399.
[poppingtags] I've had the electric Cozzee for a three years now and it's been rock solid! Can be used indoors with good ventilation (ideally near a window), if you're careful not to burn anything on the stone. Never have to worry about the weather, never have to worry about setup and never have to worry about how much gas I have left! Just as good as the electric options from Breville and Ooni. I bought mine for $400+ and thought it was a good deal at the time, this is one of the best deals I've seen for a pizza oven.
If anyone's interested, you can read more about it in the previous deal.
[m13] Sounds alright then. I'm not keen to cook with a pizza oven inside and with gas we can take it for a picnic pizza lunch down by the lake or take it camping.
Do you use a temp gun and if so do you have any recommendations?
[poppingtags] Oh nice, gas is better for camping. I don't use a temp gun, as the inbuilt thermometer is pretty spot on.
If you do need one though, AliExpress is where I got mine!
[poppingtags] @ATheoryofJustice: 450C - I can get a Neapolitan style pizza out in about 90 seconds.
[BlitzR] Where did you read about the poor quality? The majority of reviews I've been have been positive, specially for the price point.
[Dauphin3] Excellent - thanks! I had the 13" from bunnings on the fathers day pressie list. Now I can get the 17" for cheaper!
[lilviss] Got 17 inch gas to upgrade from the $169 jumbuck, thanks
[BlitzR] I'm upgrading from the $99 mistral electric oven from this deal https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/941015
[ktastrphe] Was just lamenting how long my Hizo was taking to cook our Friday pizzas after years of service. Perfect timing, just grabbed one. thanks OP
[MediumRareChicken] My friend uses the Cozze electric with great results: https://imgur.com/a/juWXZah
